Taffy settings hero stills — xhdpi derivation
==============================================

Owner:            TaffyGo
Licence:          Reserved media, not licensed with the code; see TRADEMARKS.md.
Created:          2026-08-30
Encoder:          cwebp -lossless -exact -z 9 -metadata none

Density-correct derivatives of the first-party PNG masters in vendor/masters/.
The dimensions are two thirds of the reviewed xxhdpi shipping artwork, rounded
to the nearest whole pixel. This keeps Android from decoding the 3x bitmap on
an xhdpi device.
